feature: Ellipse AroundCurve with whole-curve and surface/Brep edge picking

profiles.comparison: Full command/frontend geometry and actual history at 1e-6; ordinary/preselected and reversed/spatial lines, off-guide centers, projected axes, numeric locks and circle guides.

Full command/frontend geometry and actual history at 1e-6; arc/ellipse/NURBS/polyline guides, endpoints and kink tangents, relative input and rotated CPlanes, plus four owned surface/Brep edge clicks.
Five clean cancellations and one clean second-axis failure, all with complete input receipts, unchanged sources and no output.
Excluded zero-axis retry: native getter waits for replacement input and eventually reaches the owned input timeout; not a clean failure or successful geometry qualification.

qualifications: A shared edit-free Ellipse getter captures the closest guide location and perpendicular tangent plane; both axes are projected into that plane before radius sizing.

Whole-curve preselection, explicit whole/component picks, line endpoints, analytic/NURBS/polyline tangents, projected radius locks and resolved-center relative coordinates compare through command and frontend paths.

Complete NURBS controls, weights, knots, domains, lengths, unchanged guide geometry, selection after the command returns, and actual Undo/Redo compare for all 27 successful workflows at absolute 1e-6 on both geometry backends.
Four owned viewport edge clicks have authored edge/point and acknowledgement receipts: two planar surface edges, a box Brep edge and a curved surface edge.
Local tests verify parameter picks, filtered axes sharing preview/commit geometry, no helper objects, one history operation, source storage preservation and cancellation/mode-switch cleanup.

Source replacement, deletion, hidden/locked state and tolerance changes invalidate the local capture before and after the center; stale filters and constraints are cleared. This robustness policy is not native freshness parity.

The shared scalar length parser now yields coordinate-filter tokens such as .y to the point-filter handler instead of rejecting them as malformed numbers; existing Ellipse filter coverage now checks intermediate filter state.
Rectangle and Ellipse share the normal-frame constructor; Ellipse and Spiral/Helix probe recipes share bounded source validation without temporary geometry.
source_selection_policy: Local after compares native after_script, the returned command state. Native EndCommand after temporarily retains postselected whole-guide selection; returned/Undo/Redo snapshots release it. Preselected sources remain selected. Edge picks leave their parent unselected. Original snapshots retain both boundaries.

native_capture_provenance.purpose: Eight successful managed public getter workflows.
Nineteen successful public getter workflows including four acknowledged owned edge clicks.
Five clean cancellations, one clean failure and one separately retained timeout diagnostic; promoted rows preserve original actions and observations exactly.

metric_policy: All 27 successful native workflows qualify at absolute 1e-6 through command and frontend on both backends. Six clean no-output controls and the one timed-out zero-axis retry remain separate. Aborted malformed-source setup attempts are excluded. The earlier 55 Ellipse workflows remain regression coverage, not new native captures.
unqualified: Exhaustive physical snapping, perspective/aperture and cursor-quantized Enter parity
Exact native failure termination: local invalid axes retain the getter for correction
Extreme parameter ranges and performance parity
